review:
The Coins series at a Brazilian folk festival, with an unusual two-layer layout. When a Magic Coin lands, it activates a back grid where symbols stick and wait for the bonus.

The Boi Da Fortuna Bonus is a Hold the Jackpot round built for this layout, and Extra Lives can add up to three bonus spins at the start. The Grand is just 500x, low for the series, with medium-high volatility and a 96.14% RTP. A gentler Coins game with a theme you won't see anywhere else.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
